subject: Package when trying to install Shiny

messages.author: c0ccd549992078de
messages.subject: Package when trying to install Shiny
parts:
Hi,

I have just installed R Studio 

RStudio version 0.97.551

R version 2.14.1 (2011-12-22)
Copyright (C) 2011 The R Foundation for Statistical Computing
ISBN 3-900051-07-0
Platform: i686-pc-linux-gnu (32-bit)

And I'm getting the below error message when trying to install Shiny in RStudio

> install.packages('shiny')
Warning in install.packages :
  dependency ‘httpuv’ is not available
Installing package(s) into ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library’
(as ‘lib’ is unspecified)
Warning in install.packages :
  'lib = "/usr/local/lib/R/site-library"' is not writable
Would you like to create a personal library
~/R/i686-pc-linux-gnu-library/2.14
to install packages into?  (y/n) n
Error in install.packages : unable to install packages)

Could anyone explain to me what the error means and how I can resolve it please.

Cheers
Rae

messages.author: 402347511a5eb8b4
messages.subject: Re: Package when trying to install Shiny
parts:
Hi,
I try a guess: it's a dependancy problem. I got the problem solved upgrading R to v3.0. Actually you have to add rstudio repository in your sources.list, this will make available the latest version of R.
sudo vim /etc/apt/sources.list
http://cran.r-project.org/bin/linux/ubuntu/README
http://stackoverflow.com/questions/1401904/painless-way-to-install-a-new-version-of-r-on-windows

messages.subject: Re: Package when trying to install Shiny
parts:
Might help : 
# Install Shiny in system-wide library
sudo su - -c "R -e \"install.packages('shiny', repos='http://cran.rstudio.com/')\""
https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-server/wiki/Ubuntu-step-by-step-install-instructions
